- Ensure numeric formatting: keep same decimal places and convert to numbers (dot as decimal separator) for numeric fields.

Decision on missing/ambiguous data:
- All required fields have explicit values in text; none require guessing.
- Use the exact observed values converted to numeric where schema requires number.
